game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Harvest Fields, farm fields beyond the walls: the royal scribe must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the drawbridge.
theme: The Kingdom – Harvest Fields: farm fields beyond the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Harvest Fields, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the drawbridge. Each round, mischievous imps strike the drawbridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the drawbridge from mischievous imps in Harvest Fields: keep the energy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: energy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Harvest Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Harvest Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 67 seconds while energy > 0.
